messages.author: c20acca7dccea9e6
messages.subject: error when processing shorter days data from Geneactive actigraph
parts:
Hi, 

I seem to be getting the follow error message 
Error in if (mean(avday) > 0 & nrow(as.matrix(M$metashort)) > 1440 * (60/ws3)) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
when I try and process a CSV file that has fewer days of data, however there is still a 24hr cycle so I would expect some information. I hoping that someone may have some idea. This is the script I am using. 

library(GGIR)
g.shell.GGIR(#=======================================
             # INPUT NEEDED:
             mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
             datadir="C:/Users/leona/Documents/Thesis Data/Data/007",
             outputdir="C:/Users/leona/Documents/Thesis Data/Results/007",
             f0=1, f1=2,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 1:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: reading file, auto-calibration, and extracting features
             do.enmo = TRUE,             do.anglez=TRUE,
             chunksize=1,                printsummary=TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 2:
             #-------------------------------
             strategy = 2,               ndayswindow=7,
             hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
             maxdur = 15,                 includedaycrit = 16,
             winhr = c(5,10),
             qlevels = c(c(1380/1440),c(1410/1440)),
             qwindow=c(0,24),
             ilevels = c(seq(0,400,by=50),8000),
             mvpathreshold =c(100,120),
             bout.metric = 4,
             closedbout=FALSE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 3:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Sleep detection
             timethreshold= c(5),        anglethreshold=5,
             ignorenonwear = TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 4:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Integrating sleep log (if available) with sleep detection
             # storing day and person specific summaries of sleep
             excludefirstlast = FALSE,
             includenightcrit = 16,
             def.noc.sleep = c(),
             #loglocation= "C:/mydata/sleeplog.csv",
             outliers.only = TRUE,
             criterror = 4,
             relyonsleeplog = FALSE,
             sleeplogidnum = FALSE,
             colid=1,
             coln1=2,
             do.visual = FALSE,
             nnights = 15,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 5:
             # Key functions: Merging physical activity with sleep analyses
             #-------------------------------
             threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
             boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
             boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
             boutdur.mvpa = c(1),   timewindow = c("WW"),
             #-----------------------------------
             # Report generation
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Generating reports based on meta-data
             do.report=c(2,4,5),
             visualreport=TRUE,     dofirstpage = TRUE,
             viewingwindow=1)

thanks, 

Leona

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] error when processing shorter days data from Geneactive actigraph
parts:
Hi Leona,
Argument includedaycrit = 16,
means that you only keep days with at least 16 hours of valid data (sensor worn), which will be unrealistic if you only collect two half days of data. Lowering the threshold should give you a report per day (calendar day). Also you may want to checkout argument dayborder. See GGIR package documentation for further clarification.
Best, Vincent
